# docker_compose_top (Data Source)

Lists the processes running in a compose project's containers, like `docker compose top`. `processes` is keyed by container name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_top" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "web_processes" {
  value = data.docker_compose_top.shop.processes["shop-web-1"].processes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Optional

- `ps_args` (String) Arguments for `ps` inside each container (the Engine's `ps_args`), e.g. `-ef`. Default: the Engine's `-ef`.
- `services` (List of String) Only these services (default: every service of the project).

### Read-Only

- `container_ids` (Map of List of String) Map of service name to the IDs of its selected containers, in container-number order.
- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `top_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `processes` (Attributes Map) Container name -> ps titles and rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processes))
- `top_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object container name -> ContainerTopResponse. Sensitive: process arguments can carry secrets.

<a id="nestedatt--processes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processes`

Read-Only:

- `processes` (List of List of String) Upstream `Processes`.
- `service` (String) Upstream `Labels[com.docker.compose.service]`.
- `titles` (List of String) Upstream `Titles`.
